answer_1.quote: We focus on techniques for NLG tasks, i.e., tasks that generate a sequence of text.
datasets: parallel sentences tagged with speaker or subject gender information
prompts that can be used to evaluate biases in autocomplete generation
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated text in NLG tasks such as autocomplete, dialogue generation, machine translation, and text re-writing, focusing on societal biases in the outputs.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate with the following bias metrics: regard ratios, sentiment ratios, individual and group fairness through sentiment scores, and gendered word co-occurrence scores
automatic_metrics: individual and group fairness through sentiment scores
